svg.title: Two layers: facts and notes, and who may write each
svg.desc: Two stacked layers. Top layer, notes: Markdown files that agents write. Any agent writes with its own Ed25519 key, in its own folder. A write from another key into your folder is refused with memory_namespace_violation. Notes hold free text, so read a note as data, not as instructions. A note can cite a fact with an emem:fact token. Bottom layer, facts: measurements, each with a cell, a band, a time and a value. Only emem's own readers, enrolled devices and keys that the operator lists can write a fact. Any other key gets 403 level_too_low. A fact has no free text: a value is a number or a registry token. Both layers: anyone reads with no key (except a note of kind vault, which is stored encrypted but which the operator can still read), every write has an Ed25519 signature, and one transparency log records both.
